rules.statement: The vendor was obligated to perform specifically under the contract as no alternative mode of performance was agreed upon.
rules.supporting_quote: On the terms of the agreement to sell no alternative was made available to the vendor as to the mode of performing the contract. The return of the deposit was no alternative in any true sense. Hence the vendor was obliged to make specific performance on the purchase fulfilling his obligations. There was here no substituted obligation

meta.parties: Hubert Fernando v. Kusumananda De Silva
